Fully loaded with semi-aniline leather seating across all three rows, Super Cruise hands-free driving tech, a power panoramic sunroof, 36-speaker AKG Studio Reference sound system, and Rear Seat Entertainment, I stand ready to command every journey in supreme style!Why you'll want me in your driveway: * *Performance & Drivetrain:* Under my hood, my Duramax 3.0L Turbo-Diesel engine channels refined power through a 10-speed automatic transmission and Four Wheel Drive with a 3.23 rear axle ratio and electronic limited-slip differential. Unrivaled ride quality and heavy-duty towing precision are delivered by Air Ride Adaptive Suspension, Magnetic Ride Control, a 7,700 lbs (3,493 kg) GVWR, Heavy-Duty Trailering Package with auxiliary trailer camera and trailer tire pressure monitor system, engine block heater, brake pad monitor, and 12-spoke gloss black alloy wheels mounted on all-season tires. * *Safety & Driver Assistance:* Cruising on the open highway and maneuvering in tight spots is effortless thanks to Super Cruise hands-free driving technology, Adaptive Cruise Control, and my comprehensive safety suite. Protective features include Enhanced Automatic Emergency Braking, Reverse Automatic Braking, Forward Collision Alert, Lane Keep Assist with Lane Departure Warning, Trailer Side Blind Zone Alert, Rear Cross Traffic Alert, HD Surround Vision, Enhanced Automatic Parking Assist, Front and Rear Pedestrian Alert, Safety Alert Seat, Auto Seat Belt Tightening, Adaptive Headlamp System, and a specialized Theft-Deterrent Package. * *Audio & Infotainment Tech:* My ultra-luxurious digital cockpit centers around a curved 16.9-inch diagonal OLED infotainment screen with embedded navigation, a 14.2-inch OLED reconfigurable cluster display, and a 7.2-inch OLED control panel. Tech connectivity amenities include an AKG Studio Reference 36-Speaker Audio System with front-to-rear conversation enhancement, Rear Seat Entertainment System, Head-Up Display, Rear Camera Mirror, Wireless Apple CarPlay, Wireless Android Auto, wireless device charging, SiriusXM capability, and 3 years of OnStar and Connected Services. * *Interior Comfort & Convenience:* Settle into Jet Black semi-aniline leather seats across all three rows featuring heated and ventilated front seats, power-release heated 2nd-row bucket seats, and power-folding 3rd-row 60/40 split-bench seats with leather-wrapped interior trim. Cabin luxuries include a power panoramic sunroof, heated steering wheel, tri-zone automatic climate control, selectable interior lighting, power tilt/telescopic steering column, memory settings, 110-volt power outlet, passive entry with keyless start, and dealer-installed all-weather floor liners and cargo liner. * *Exterior Style & Utility:* I show off an assertive, blacked-out stance highlighted by my Black Raven finish, Onyx Package gloss black accents, black roof rack cross rails, illuminated door handles, and adaptive LED lighting. Exterior utility features include a hands-free power liftgate, power-folding heated side mirrors with auto-dimming and memory settings, and a monochromatic Cadillac emblem.With smooth Duramax Turbo-Diesel power, Air Ride Adaptive Suspension, Super Cruise tech, and 36-speaker AKG audio luxury, I am the ultimate flagship SUV for executive travel and family adventures. Remote-start my diesel engine, turn on the ventilated semi-aniline leather seats, and let's go command the open road together!===== The Baglier Buyers Program =====Every vehicle purchase includes the following complimentary benefits: * *FREE Lifetime State Inspections* -- Included with any new or used vehicle purchase. * *FREE Oil Change* -- Included with any new vehicle purchase. * *FREE Loaner Car Program* -- Available for your service needs. * *FREE Multi-Point Inspection* -- Provided with every service visit. * *FREE Car Wash* -- Included with any service or body shop visit.

  • Distance pacing cruise control with traffic stop-go. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with Distance pacing cruise control with traffic stop-go, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and the vehicle ahead. It's stop/go feature automatically brings the vehicle to a stop if traffic stops and resumes distance pacing cruise when traffic starts to move again. Distance pacing cruise control with traffic stop-go, your ultimate co-pilot.
Safety and Security
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
  • Lane departure prevention - Keep it between the lines. It only takes a moment of inattention for your vehicle to drift. With lane departure prevention, your vehicle takes corrective action to help you avoid unintentionally moving out of your lane. Lane departure prevention is an extra level of safety for you and those around you.
  • Active blind spot system - Protect your blind side. You checked the mirror, looked over your shoulder and still nearly collided with the car next to you. An active blind spot system not only alerts you to the presence of a vehicle to your sides or rear but helps prevent you from making an unsafe lane change. Replace fear and uncertainty with the confidence and safety of the Active blind spot system.
Technology and Telematics
  • Smart device mirroring - Smartphone, meet smart car. You can control your device through your vehicle's infotainment system. Smart device mirroring brings together safety and convenience by making it easier to find what you're looking for while keeping your eyes on the road.

Its advanced technology suite ensures drivers stay connected and entertained on every journey.

A limited-slip center differential enhances traction and stability, especially in challenging conditions. The SUV’s full-time four-wheel drive system ensures optimal power distribution, providing confident handling whether on or off-road. These features combine to offer a balanced driving experience that emphasizes both performance and reliability.

description:
The 2023 Land Rover Defender 130 First Edition is built for buyers who want genuine capability without giving up luxury, comfort, or road presence. Finished in Fuji White with a Light Oyster Windsor leather interior and Lunar accents, this Defender has a refined, upscale look that fits just as naturally in the city as it does heading toward Tahoe, the mountains, or a weekend getaway.

The Defender 130 stretches the iconic Defender formula into a spacious three-row SUV, giving you substantially more passenger and cargo versatility while retaining the rugged character that has made the modern Defender so desirable. All-wheel drive provides confident traction in changing road and weather conditions, while the long, commanding body gives the 130 a presence that stands apart from more conventional luxury SUVs.

This First Edition is especially well appointed. The cabin features Light Oyster Windsor leather seating, Natural Light Oak veneer, a distinctive white cross-car beam, and a thoughtfully designed interior that feels modern without losing the Defender s utilitarian character. The 60/40 load-through climate rear seats with center armrest add flexibility for passengers and cargo, while the Rear Seat Convenience Pack makes the second-row area even more comfortable for family, friends, and longer trips.

The Cold Climate Pack makes this Defender especially appealing for winter travel and trips into colder climates, while the Extended Bright Exterior Pack gives the Fuji White exterior an elevated, premium appearance. The 22-inch Style 5098 five-spoke Gloss Sparkle Silver wheels fill out the Defender s substantial stance beautifully, and this example is also equipped with a matching 22-inch full-size spare wheel.

For buyers who plan to put the Defender s capability to use, this one is equipped with the Towing Package and Towing Pack 2, adding even more versatility for trailers, recreational equipment, and weekend adventures. The Handover Pack further complements the vehicle s factory equipment and First Edition specification.

What makes the Defender 130 so appealing is how much it can do without feeling like a traditional truck-based SUV. It gives you three-row space, sophisticated materials, unmistakable Land Rover styling, strong all-weather capability, and the kind of versatility that works equally well for family duty, business use, road trips, or recreational travel.

If you have been looking for a Defender 130 with the right color combination, premium First Edition equipment, towing capability, and a highly desirable interior specification, this Fuji White example deserves a closer look.

Contact us to schedule a test drive, discuss financing or trade-in options, or get started with your purchase.

Step into a world of effortless capability and refined comfort with this one-owner 2025 Toyota Grand Highlander Limited Hybrid AWD, finished in a sophisticated Storm Cloud exterior that turns heads at every arrival. Assembled with care in Princeton, Indiana, this three-row hybrid SUV delivers the perfect fusion of efficiency, space, and modern sophistication for families who demand more from every mile.

Under the hood, a refined 2.5-liter four-cylinder hybrid powertrain pairs with an advanced electronically controlled continuously variable transmission to deliver smooth, responsive power while achieving an impressive 34 mpg combined. All-wheel drive with Trail Mode and a confident 3,500-pound towing capacity open the door to weekend escapes, light trail exploration, or simply navigating rain-slicked roads with total assurance.

Outside, bold 20-inch alloy wheels, crisp LED headlights, taillights, and fog lights create a commanding presence, while heated power outside mirrors, rain-sensing wipers, a hands-free power liftgate, and Smart Key with push-button start make every arrival and departure seamless. The panoramic moonroof invites open-air freedom, flooding the cabin with natural light, and the panoramic view camera system transforms parking and tight maneuvers into effortless experiences. Protective all-weather floor liners and a cargo tray stand ready for whatever life throws your way.

Inside, leather-trimmed seating for seven surrounds you in premium comfort. Heated, ventilated, and power-adjustable front seats, a heated steering wheel, and heated second-row outboard seats keep everyone cozy, while the versatile 60/40 split fold-flat third row and integrated second-row window sunshades adapt instantly to passengers or cargo. Three-zone automatic climate control maintains perfect comfort throughout the cabin, and thoughtful details like a Qi wireless smartphone charger, seven USB-C ports, ten cup and bottle holders, and a robust 1500-watt inverter with dual 120-volt outlets keep devices powered and adventures uninterrupted.

Technology elevates every drive with a vibrant 12.3-inch Toyota Audio Multimedia touchscreen featuring eleven premium JBL speakers, wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility, and SiriusXM readiness. A matching 12.3-inch digital gauge cluster keeps vital information front and center, while Toyota Safety Sense 3.0 with Pre-Collision System, front and rear parking assist with automatic braking, Blind Spot Monitor with Rear Cross-Traffic Alert, and the full Star Safety System deliver peace of mind on every journey.

This one-owner Grand Highlander Limited Hybrid stands ready to redefine family travel with its rare combination of hybrid efficiency, expansive space, and upscale appointments.

This 2025 Honda Pilot Elite offers the combination of capability and comfort that defines a premium three-row family SUV, with the proven reliability that makes ownership straightforward and enjoyable.

- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration
- Bose Premium Sound System with 12 speakers
- Three-row seating for seven passengers
- Adaptive Cruise Control with Low-Speed Follow
- Power moonroof
- Heated and ventilated front bucket seats
- Heated steering wheel
- Honda Satellite-Linked Navigation System
- Lane Keeping Assist System
- Blind Spot Information System
- Trailer hitch
- 20-inch wheels
- Auto High-beam Headlights
- Power liftgate
- Remote start capability

The Elite trim elevates the driving experience with leather seating surfaces and dual-zone automatic climate control that keeps front passengers comfortable at different temperature preferences. The heated and ventilated front seats provide year-round comfort, while heated rear seats extend that luxury to second-row passengers. Memory settings for the power driver seat ensure every trip begins exactly as you prefer, and the heated steering wheel adds an appreciated touch during colder months.

Navigation and connectivity define modern driving convenience. The Honda Satellite-Linked Navigation System guides you precisely to your destination, while Apple CarPlay and Android Auto allow seamless integration of your smartphone. SiriusXM satellite radio with a 12-speaker Bose premium audio system delivers quality sound for every journey. HondaLink subscription services keep you connected to your vehicle remotely, offering added peace of mind.

Safety technology provides active assistance on the road. Adaptive Cruise Control maintains your chosen distance from traffic ahead, Lane Keeping Assist helps you stay centered in your lane, and the Blind Spot Information System alerts you to vehicles in your blind spots. Auto High-beam Headlights optimize visibility while the backup camera provides clear rear views during parking maneuvers.

The 3.5L V6 engine with 10-speed automatic transmission and all-wheel drive delivers capable performance while achieving 19 city and 25 highway mpg. Three-row seating accommodates your entire family with a reclining third-row seat that flexes to your needs, and the power liftgate makes loading cargo effortless. The trailer hitch opens possibilities for weekend adventures or hauling projects.

This black Elite represents the practical luxury you want in a family SUV. Contact us to schedule a test drive and discover why the Pilot Elite continues to be the choice for families who demand more.
